errors.text_span: Диаграмата е разделена на пет сектори
errors.evidence: The pie chart is visibly divided into four sectors, not five. The legend lists five categories, but one of them (Под 1 година) has a value of 0% and is not represented by a slice in the chart.

errors.text_span: Първият сектор, отляво и в горната част, е синьо и отговаря на 31,8% от общия брой, представящ отговори под 1 година.
errors.evidence: This sentence contains multiple errors mapping attributes to the purple slice (31.8%). It incorrectly identifies the color as blue ('синьо') when it is purple. It also incorrectly assigns the label 'под 1 година' (under 1 year), which corresponds to the 0% category, instead of the correct label 'Над 31 години' (over 31 years).

The description omits the category labels for three of the four visible sectors. It fails to state that the orange slice (36.4%) corresponds to 'От 6 до 15 години', the green slice (18.2%) to 'От 16 до 30 години', and the red slice (13.6%) to 'Над 1 до 5 години'.
The description incorrectly identifies the purple sector (31.8%) as the largest ('Най-дългият сектор'). The largest sector is the orange one, which represents 36.4%.
The value for the purple sector is clearly labeled as 31.8% in the chart, not 31%.

The description incorrectly assigns the label 'от 6 до 15 години' (from 6 to 15 years) to the purple sector. The purple sector actually represents 'Над 31 години' (over 31 years). The 'от 6 до 15 години' category corresponds to the orange slice.

errors.text_span: Диаграмата включва легенда, която идентифицира всеки сектор със съответния процент.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the legend identifies sectors by their percentage. The legend actually maps colors to category labels (time durations), while the percentage values are displayed directly inside the pie slices.
The generation prompt asks to mention if the chart includes 'етикети с проценти вътре в секторите' (labels with percentages inside the sectors). The description omits this key feature of the chart.
